name: The Ethironal Shrine
desc:
The **Second Layer** of The Depths starts with the Ethironal Shrine, a bridge between Scyphozia and the resting chamber of Ethiron. It consists of the Shrine, the Maw, and the Sanctuary. All leading into the Cathedral. Just be wary of the **parasites** coating the floor like strange snow.

Below the first floor lies the [Sleeping City](location:new_kyrsa), more detail can be found on its respective page.
additional_info:
-   The ambient music for this area is The Killing Wind, Whisperwind, and The Storm that Speaks by Naktigonis.
-   The combat music for this area is INSOMNIA by Naktigonis.
    -   As stated in the video, the music present in game is altered due to ROBLOX's guidelines regarding screaming and distorted audio.
-   Mute, Gliders, and Teleportation all do not work in this dungeon.
-   The Bone Keeper spawned at the bridge to the generator is only weakened so it has dramatically less knockback and cannot ragdoll you.
-   Murmur: Tacet is able to be used.
-   While Dimensional Travel is able to be used, it instead flings the user similar to the winds.
-   The Lighthook will recharge even if you're not ingame or on that slot.
-   Activating the generator will spawn a bounder.
-   There is a frozen yeti at the side of Firfire, it looks very similar to the Yeti found in Rogue Lineage
